name: Work stalled → detect lack of progress → recover, fail or escalate
purpose: Distinguish work that is taking a long time from work that has stopped, and recover only where the side effects are known.
categoryTitle: Processing, queues, async work & operational reliability
entityScope: the individual in-flight work item and the worker that holds it

name: Retryable failure → backoff → retry → resolve or exhaust
purpose: Repeat a transient failure within a bounded budget, only where repeating is safe and the work is still wanted.
categoryTitle: Processing, queues, async work & operational reliability
entityScope: the work item together with its durable attempt history

name: Duplicate work detected → deduplicate → reuse, suppress or reconcile
purpose: Stop the same logical operation running twice, without collapsing two legitimate repeats into one.
categoryTitle: Processing, queues, async work & operational reliability
entityScope: the logical business operation, and the work instances claiming to be it

name: Partial processing → preserve completed work → retry only the failed scope
purpose: Recover the part of a composite operation that failed, without re-running the part that worked.
categoryTitle: Processing, queues, async work & operational reliability
entityScope: the composite job and each child operation individually

name: Dead-letter entry → diagnose → replay, correct or close
purpose: Turn work that automation could not finish into an obligation someone owns, rather than a queue nobody reads.
categoryTitle: Processing, queues, async work & operational reliability
entityScope: the dead-lettered item, linked to the original work it came from

name: Worker or processor failure → reclaim work → resume safely
purpose: Move execution responsibility off a failed worker without assuming the work failed and without letting two workers hold it.
categoryTitle: Processing, queues, async work & operational reliability
entityScope: the failed worker and each in-flight work item it owned

name: Backlog recovery → revalidate → controlled drain → normal state
purpose: Work through an accumulated backlog deliberately, discarding what has gone stale and pacing what has not.
categoryTitle: Processing, queues, async work & operational reliability
entityScope: the accumulated backlog, inventoried by workload class

name: Technical completion → verify business outcome → finalize or reconcile
purpose: Check that the state a job existed to create actually exists, wherever the job's own success is not proof of it.
categoryTitle: Processing, queues, async work & operational reliability
entityScope: the completed technical job and the business entity it was meant to change

name: Work created → routing → assignment
purpose: Get new work into the smallest responsibility scope that is genuinely valid, and refuse to invent one where the policy is silent.
entityScope: the individual work item - a case, lead, opportunity, task or request

name: Assignment → acceptance → active responsibility
purpose: Keep proposed responsibility and accepted responsibility as different states, so work nobody has taken is visible as such.
entityScope: the work item plus this specific assignment of it

name: Owner assignment → context transfer → work start
purpose: Give a new owner what they need to continue an existing obligation, rather than an entity with their name on it.
entityScope: the business entity plus the owner now responsible for it

name: Ownership change → transfer obligations → continue
purpose: Move responsibility for an active entity without losing anything that was already owed, without letting the clock restart, and without rewriting who did what before the change.
entityScope: the business entity, its previous owner and its next one

name: Responsibility escalation → higher authority → resolution or return
purpose: Move a blocker up to the level that can clear it, without the original owner putting the work down by raising it.
entityScope: the work item plus its ownership chain

name: Approval request → review → approve, reject or request changes
purpose: Bind an approval to the exact version reviewed, and keep approving separate from doing.
entityScope: the approval request, bound to one specific version of the subject

name: Multi-party approval → aggregate required decisions → authorised or blocked
purpose: Combine several genuinely independent approval decisions strictly according to the governing policy, and refuse to proceed where no policy defines how.
entityScope: the approval package, the action and subject version it authorises, and each authority's individual decision

name: Material change after approval → impact check → re-approval or continue
purpose: Work out whether an approval still covers what the subject has become, and re-open only the decisions whose basis stopped being true.
entityScope: the approved subject, its version history and the approvals bound to those versions

name: Approval rejected → revision eligibility → resubmit or close
purpose: Keep rejection from being either a dead end by default or a retry loop, and make sure a rejected version cannot quietly execute later.
entityScope: the rejected approval request and the exact subject version it rejected

name: Decision authority change → revalidate pending decisions → transfer or continue
purpose: Re-evaluate decisions against who is actually authorised now, without unapproving history or blindly moving what is pending.
entityScope: the decision process plus the authority holders whose scope changed

name: Entity relationship created → validate → activate or reject
purpose: Create a link between two entities only where the relationship itself has an authoritative basis, and keep it a link rather than a consolidation.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the relationship, plus the two entities it connects, in the direction it was created

name: Relationship change → recalculate rights and obligations → continue
purpose: Recalculate exactly what depended on a relationship when it changes, and nothing else.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the relationship that changed and the entities connected by it

name: Relationship end → remove future dependency → reconcile existing obligations
purpose: Stop what a relationship was carrying forward without cancelling what it validly produced.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the relationship that ended and the entities it connected

name: Role change → authority and capability delta → apply
purpose: Move what someone may do next, by the difference between two roles, without disturbing what they did under the old one.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the person or member, the role, and the account or organisation the role is held in

name: Parent state change → determine child impact → propagate selectively
purpose: Let a parent's state reach only the children that genuinely depend on it, through a rule someone actually wrote.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the parent whose state changed, and each child evaluated individually against the dependency model

name: Child state change → recalculate aggregate parent state
purpose: Derive a parent's state from its children through an explicit aggregation policy, recomputed from source rather than nudged by whichever child reported last.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the parent and the full collection of children the policy reads

name: Duplicate entity detected → assess → keep separate, link or merge
purpose: Assess whether two records are the same entity, and route the answer - without consolidating anything.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the candidate set of records suspected of representing one entity

name: Entity link → shared context → preserve independent identity
purpose: Record that two entities are related and let defined context cross between them, while both remain two entities.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the link itself, plus the two entities it connects

name: Entity split required → create separate records → allocate history and state safely
purpose: Separate what should never have been one record, or what must now be managed apart, without copying the things that do not divide.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the source entity and the entities that result from the split

name: Required relationship missing → orphan state → resolve or reassign
purpose: Make a missing required relationship an explicit, findable state rather than a null field that active work quietly runs against.
categoryTitle: Account structure, identity relationships & entity reconciliation
entityScope: the entity missing its required relationship, and the relationship type that is absent

name: Post-completion issue → validate → remedy route
purpose: Establish whether something delivered has left an obligation unresolved, and which recovery mechanism could satisfy it.
entityScope: the completed fulfillment or service, and the specific problem reported against it

name: Return request → eligibility → authorize, reject or review
purpose: Decide whether something may enter a return process, as a decision separate from whether money is owed.
entityScope: the return request and the original fulfillment it concerns

name: Return authorized → in transit, received, lost or expired
purpose: Track whether an authorised return actually comes back, and hold the states where it might not have.
entityScope: the authorised return and the resource travelling under it

name: Returned item or deliverable → inspect → accept, reject or partial
purpose: Judge what came back against the conditions it was authorised under, keeping receipt and acceptance apart.
entityScope: the returned resource as received, and the return case it arrived under

name: Replacement decision → allocate → fulfill → confirm
purpose: Deliver a second time against the same promise, tied to the defect it exists to resolve.
entityScope: the replacement case, linking the original fulfillment to the new one

name: Reperformance or correction → execute → verify corrected outcome
purpose: Produce the outcome that should have been produced, while the record still shows that the first one was wrong.
entityScope: the original fulfillment or service, and the corrective obligation created against it

name: Remedy selection → resolve obligation → financial handoff if needed
purpose: Choose the remedy that would actually satisfy the unresolved obligation, from the ones that genuinely exist.
entityScope: the confirmed issue and the unresolved obligation behind it

name: Remedy execution → verify outcome → close or continue recovery
purpose: Check that the remedy actually satisfied the obligation, rather than that it was carried out.
entityScope: the remedy and the issue it was chosen to resolve

name: Compensation decision → eligibility → grant or reject → deliver
purpose: Decide separately whether impact warrants something beyond fixing the problem, and confirm it actually arrived.
entityScope: the compensation case and the experience or issue that prompted it
